question: Compare the resistivities of metals, semiconductors, and insulators. Explain why metals are good conductors of electricity.

options.A: Metals have the highest resistivity, semiconductors have the lowest resistivity, and insulators have intermediate resistivity; metals conduct because they have no free electrons.
options.B: Metals, semiconductors, and insulators have nearly equal resistivities; metals conduct only because their atoms are heavier.
options.C: Semiconductors have lower resistivity than metals, while insulators have higher resistivity; metals conduct because positive ions move freely.
options.D: Metals have very low resistivity, semiconductors have intermediate resistivity, and insulators have very high resistivity; metals are good conductors because they have many free electrons available for drift.
